fields.name: site
fields.label: Site

options.notes: From useEnvData (useEnvData.ts:34-41). mapLocationOptions encodes the value as 'dcim-location:["<location_type>","<id>"]' when location_type is present (location-options.ts:21-36). location_type is a repeated static query param.

fields.query_param_normalization: Resolved against loaded locations by encoded value, provider id, or display name (resolveLocationFormValue); unresolvable value clears site and device (workflow.tsx:228-246).
client_only_validation: UI-only field, required: trimmed min 1 'Site is required' (workflow.tsx:41)
fields.submit_transform: Not submitted; it only filters the device option query (site and site_type).

fields.name: tenant
fields.label: Tenant (optional)
fields.query_param_normalization: Multi-value (searchParams.getAll('tenant')), empty strings dropped (workflow.tsx:167-170). After options load, only values that exist in the loaded options are kept (workflow.tsx:279-288).
fields.submit_transform: Not submitted. Each value is sent as a repeated 'tenant' query param on the device option request (workflow.tsx:206-218).

fields.name: status
fields.label: Status (optional)
fields.query_param_normalization: Multi-value (getAll('status')), empty strings dropped (workflow.tsx:171-174). Filtered to values in the loaded options (workflow.tsx:291-300).
fields.submit_transform: Not submitted. Each value is sent as a repeated 'status' query param on the device option request (workflow.tsx:209-218).

fields.name: device_id
fields.label: Device
fields.schema_description: Identifier of the network device to reprovision.

options.notes: The platform filter is a repeated static param passed as deviceFilterParams (reprovisionworkflow/form/page.tsx:49). tenant/status arrays are sent as repeated params, and site_type is decoded from the encoded site value (useDevices.ts:42-50). There is no request until site is set (useDevices.ts:54). All depended-on fields are UI-only.

fields.query_param_normalization: Kept only if present in the loaded device options, otherwise cleared (workflow.tsx:248-262).
fields.submit_transform: UI form field 'device' is renamed to 'device_id' (page.tsx:32-34).

payload_transform: onSubmit (reprovisionworkflow/form/page.tsx:30-43) POSTs {"device_id": data.device} to /v1/workflow/ngc/reprovision through startWorkflow (utils.tsx:153-183). site, tenant and status are filter-only. DeviceWorkflowForm's commit_confirm state (default true, workflow.tsx:45,183) is not rendered (showCommitConfirm=false) and not sent.
discrepancies: The schema has a single required device_id (reprovision.py:71-77). The UI also requires a UI-only Site and offers Tenant/Status filters, none of which are submitted.

The UI limits the device list to platform 'Cumulus Linux' or 'NV-OS' plus managed_only (page.tsx:49). The input model has no platform constraint, and ReprovisionWorkflow has no platform check comparable to os_upgrade.py:177.
The destructive-warning banner (page.tsx:50, workflow.tsx:409-416) is UI-only text with no schema counterpart.
Label 'Device' differs from schema title 'Device Id'.
The spec test 'only shows Cumulus Linux devices' (reprovisionForm.spec.ts:52-88) checks only Cumulus Linux, but the filter also admits NV-OS.
contract_gaps: The UI-only site/tenant/status filter fields have no schema properties. ui_schema.fields can only key model fields, so these filters must be internal to device_reference, whose filter set v1 does not specify.

OptionSource.params is scalar-only, but the device options need the repeated static params platform=Cumulus Linux&platform=NV-OS. The location options likewise need location_type=Site&location_type=Module.
depends_on maps one query param to one sibling field. Here tenant/status are arrays sent as repeated params, and site_type is derived from the selected site option's location_type.
There is no field- or form-level warning hint for the destructive banner; it could degrade to 'help' on device_id.
